title: Long campaigns open faster: earlier history loads when you ask
summary: Shared campaigns with long ledgers, chats and many archived sessions now open with their newest lines, and older history loads on request.
items: The ledger, Full activity, Finances and Chat open with their newest lines. Load earlier entries and Load earlier messages fetch older ones, and a search or filter loads them by itself.
Archived sessions in Journal and Reports show Load this session and open their full record when chosen.
Totals that span the whole campaign say when they only cover what is loaded and offer Load all history. Fairness and favour-whoever-is-behind load what they need before comparing.

Download a copy and online backups load the whole campaign first, so a backup still holds every entry. Nothing is deleted: everything stays online and players still only see what their own view includes.
